blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Life & Annuities — digital workers, decision hubs and self-healing workflows — governed autonomy at enterprise scale applied to the life & annuities operating unit of Insurance & Risk.

Life books run on decades-long promises: underwriting quality at issue, servicing responsiveness across 30-year relationships, and actuarial integrity across regime changes (IFRS 17/LDTI). The machinery deciding those outcomes is data and document heavy — ideal ground for governed automation.

items: APS records, paramedical data and financial underwriting arrive as documents; assembly consumes days per case.
Surrender, loan and beneficiary transactions route through document-heavy queues with abandonment risk.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Intelligent Document Processing, Agentic Process Automation, Autonomous Workflow Orchestration from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Underwriting evidence assembly, Policy servicing transactions, Claims/beneficiary processing) on Achala Swarm and Achala Nexus and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — IFRS 17 / LDTI among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: See the work as it actually runs — event-log truth before you automate anything.
One automation spine — APIs, events, RPA and agents composable under common control.
Self-healing workflows — long-running business processes that adapt, retry and recover without tickets.
APS/paramedical/financial docs classified, extracted and assembled (case cycle time down 40-60%)
